nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: React DOM preloading APIs (prefetchDNS, preconnect, preload, preloadModule, preinit, preinitModule) let server components start loading critical resources before the client even receives the HTML, reducing load time. Impact: HIGH.
